study.question: Does correct recipient assignment of the positive-label force explain the positive-orientation preference after removing the prediction-only auxiliary source component?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g3-r0071 positive-label-only source AUC is0.6688260412608873 aligned versus0.6682300757043065 reversed (aligned-minus-reversed=0.0005959655565808), opposite the full-source bridge (0.6683760511656333 aligned versus0.6689610675617089 reversed; difference=-0.0005850163960756). Zero-target-only g3-r0070 has a much smaller sign difference. These single-seed contrasts do not establish why. At fixed state, BCE(y)-BCE(0) has unsaturated logit derivative -y. Hypothesis: recipient-aligned sparse positive-label forces, rather than their marginal counts alone, support the positive-orientation preference. A joint whole-batch cycle of auxiliary label tuples should attenuate that preference. Full-source label cycling in g3-r0066 retained the prediction component p; it did not isolate this -y source. Earlier g3-r0068 removed the label mean and also changed source content. The present replacement retains binary-label sparsity and tuple counts, while changing only assignment within the positive-label source. This is a prospective attribution experiment, not a claim of new best performance.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent: retain its complete forward architecture, true-label private learning, native geometry and BCE-difference source construction. Add a native-versus-fixed-batch-cycle label assignment factor, crossed with both existing external signs.

Its receipt documents alternate-label auxiliary BCE as a bit source, with full derivative p-y_source. This experiment isolates the BCE difference with derivative -y_source, so it removes the prediction-only component while preserving the positive-label histogram.

inherited_components: Entire standalone g3-r0071 positive-label source model, including feature embeddings, compressed uniform/feedback pooling, masked target-match/position/ordinal/quadratic summaries, task residual bank and product context/history corrections.
True-label joint BCE, extra source VJP stopping at collection outputs, zero-valued detached-cotangent surrogate, seven identity edges and first-order custom backward.

study.proposed_difference: Add source_label_assignment native|batch_cycle. All cells compute BCE(true), BCE(roll(true)), and BCE(0) for auxiliary heads through the same recipient graph; source coefficients are (1,0,-1) or (0,1,-1). Use a deterministic torch.roll by4097 on the complete [8192,4] detached training-label matrix, including empty-history rows; the cycled click column is never used in any loss.4097 is coprime to8192, so the permutation has no fixed rows and a single noninvolutive cycle, preserving all auxiliary tuple counts. Only the detached source VJP chooses the bit; actual four-task BCE, private gradients and native radius/line/support remain true-label. No source-label access occurs in forward or eval. Four standalone modules differ only in assignment and external orientation CONFIG/defaults. This is a surrogate VJP rather than the ordinary gradient of the displayed scalar loss. Novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Validity bridge first: native aligned and reversed controls should match same-sign g3-r0071 positive-label receipts within absolute click AUC1e-6 and show identical fixed-state predictions, parameter/buffer layout and ordinary private-task gradients. Failures halt attribution rather than trigger tuning on feedback.

At frozen-state host probes, the donor mapping must preserve exact per-task positive counts and joint auxiliary tuples, move all rows including empty histories, and change at least some source bits on active native-transfer batches. Preserve native support/radius/line, real objective value and private gradients. Report bit-disagreement fraction, sign balance, zero-source/tangent/line gates, clamp frequency, source norms, pivot ties and post-cast residuals where the existing authorized host can collect these. The optional diagnostic function alone does not imply collection.

Primary predeclared descriptive contrast: D_native=AUC(native,aligned)-AUC(native,reversed); D_cycle analogously. Assignment-specific hypothesis predicts D_native>0 and D_native-D_cycle>0.0001 after successful bridges; this threshold guides follow-up, not statistical significance. Also report all four AUCs and the full2x2 difference of differences, including contrary signs.

Report click and all auxiliary AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, sample/positive/negative counts and inherited history bins empty,1..16,17..64,>64. No timestamp/frequency slices are invented from unavailable inputs. Report parameters, measured allocated GPU/wall seconds, examples, peak memory, throughput and p50/p95 batch latency. Fixed-state eval should be identical; trained checkpoints may differ. No speed claim without measured cost.
falsifiers: If native bridges reproduce and the cycled positive-label source retains the native positive-orientation gap to within0.0001 (or improves it) with demonstrated active-batch bit changes, the claim that correct assignment is necessary for this preference is weakened in this setting. A changed bit with no AUC effect is negative evidence, not a success.

If donor bits do not differ where native transfer is active, a null AUC contrast is an ineffective intervention and cannot test label necessity. If bridge, private-gradient, graph, support/radius or forward parity fails, classify as implementation failure, retain cost and repair before scientific interpretation.

If effects reverse or vanish under later authorized paired seeds/user-cluster uncertainty, retain only preliminary seed-specific observations. If no repeatable click advantage over click-only remains under frozen matched comparisons, useful auxiliary supervision is unsupported. Present2x2 tests alone cannot establish global necessity or generalization.
alternative_explanations: A fixed donor cycle does not create independent labels; batch order, repeated users and cross-row Dice Jacobians can retain association. Entire auxiliary label tuples and their histogram are preserved, but recipient conditional distributions change.

The bit extractor is nonlinear. Equal label marginals and fixed native transfer radius do not imply equal bit distributions, source VJP norms, or optimizer trajectories. Source cancellation, clamps, pivot/degeneracy behavior and the FP64-to-model cast may matter.

Native transfer geometry, private task learning, click gradients and all later states still use true auxiliary labels. This tests their necessity for the bit source only; it does not show that auxiliary labels are globally unnecessary.

No bit probes were automatically collected in earlier receipts. The existing optional source_bit_diagnostics is callable but not automatically collected by the documented host API. Absent fixed-state bit disagreement and parity checks, report an end-to-end assignment contrast with mechanism attribution unresolved.

One frozen training seed, many adaptively selected historical trials, no user-cluster uncertainty and no held-out evidence. Same-seed replay is implementation reproducibility, not independent repetition.

Raw parquet files, training tensors and a callable training validator are not supplied in this proposal workspace. Baseline source digest matches the contract, but raw-data hashes and forward/backward/masking preflight cannot be independently rerun here. Host preflight must verify the frozen identities and information boundary; unavailable inputs are not scientific counterevidence.
